items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: I know Zeb, you're all here at some time.

ctx.x: Remember Zeb? Zeb, yeah, I know Zeb. What was his name? I could never get that straight.
I can't say Zeb's last name, but that's his people over the street. There's some of his cousins and things.
Right across the street? Mm-hmm. That house? Yeah. 2117. Yeah. Well, we'd like to go talk to them sometime.
